replacements.en: I develop agent infrastructure and orchestration for software engineering, with MCP & A2A integration and human-in-the-loop workflow design. I build Kubernetes platforms and shared DevSecOps release pipelines used in production by multiple customers. I enjoy working with AWS and Google Cloud and prefer them for cloud projects.

replacements.en: Built and operated a bare-metal RKE2 platform with encrypted etcd and mTLS for inter-DC Kafka, service-to-service traffic, PostgreSQL and Redis. Managed certificates centrally in Vault and propagated updates using External Secrets Operator (ESO), webhooks and Ansible.

replacements.en: Built a Jenkins DevSecOps pipeline for 30–40 microservices: Jira-triggered releases with shared Helm charts, security checks, tests and approvals. Build and delivery took ~5 min for >6 services. Full releases with cross-department approvals completed within a day. The pipeline remained in use and supported new services after my departure.
